text: Borrowed Steps is a human approved community equipment lending workflow for a real neighborhood inventory.
This is a live hosted release on Vercel Hobby, with Neon Free PostgreSQL and a zero spend deployment.
A volunteer starts a synthetic evaluation workspace and immediately sees available equipment, versions, and quarantined items.
The intake assistant is a read only Strands and Groq adapter. It prepares a structured draft, while the human remains in control.
A request records the borrower label, equipment kind, pickup location, and an explicit timezone aware due date.
Allocation is a deliberate volunteer decision. The interface requires confirmation before a reservation is created.
Pickup is confirmed in person, and every state transition is written to the audit stream with version and idempotency protection.
The deterministic path stays usable when the model is busy. Public code and the live release link are provided with this demo.
